_doc: Recall campaign-number ledger. gate-check fails on any campaign number in deployed HTML not present here. Numbers move from unverified_legacy to verified ONLY with a primary source (NHTSA API / Part 573 PDF). Audit queue: work unverified_legacy down to zero.

16V061.component: Takata driver inflator: 2007-2011 CR-V, 2009-2013 Fit, 2007-2014 Ridgeline, 2007-2016 RDX, 2009-2014 TL et al

21V090.component: 2021 F-150 / 2020-2021 Super Duty windshield bonding (FMVSS 212, paint flow additive); Ford 21C06

21V653.component: 2021 F-150 Super Cab front seat-belt webbing misrouted (~16,430 units); Ford 21C20

22V077.component: Pacifica PHEV high-voltage battery fire (Z11, 2017-2018) — superseded by 24V536

24V536.component: Pacifica PHEV battery fire re-recall, 2017-2018 (Z11 remedy ineffective)

24V538.component: Pacifica PHEV battery fire, 2019-2021 (LGES alt-line cells, FCA 72B)

18V395.component: Pacifica Manual Park Release rollaway (U50, 2017-2018, FMVSS 114)

18V579.component: Prius engine wire harness fire (J0T, 2016-2018, 192,347 units)

19V544.component: Brake booster pump (K0L): 2019 Prius, 2019-2020 Prius Prime, 2019 RAV4 Hybrid, 2020 Corolla Hybrid

19V876.component: 2019 Prius combination meter blank display (19TA21, FMVSS 101, 3,751 units)

25V236.component: Brake master cylinder leak, 2017-2018 F-150/Expedition/Navigator 3.5L EcoBoost (25S37, expands 22V150/20V332)

22V150.component: Brake master cylinder, 2016-2018 F-150 + 2016-2017 Expedition/Navigator 3.5L EcoBoost (22S11)

20V332.component: Brake master cylinder, 2014-2017 F-150 3.5L EcoBoost (20S31, 292,311 units)

25V010.component: Side-curtain airbag inflator rupture (Joyson), 2016/2018-2019 Ram 1500 Classic, 1,879 units

17V663.component: 2016-2017 Rogue rear seat recliner welds (PC592, FMVSS 207/210, 4,883 units) — Rogue ONLY

16V244.component: OCS passenger airbag reflash: 2013-2016 Altima/Leaf/Pathfinder/NV200/Sentra, 2014-2016 Rogue, 2015-2016 Murano, 2016 Maxima — NOT 2017+ and NOT Infiniti

22V486.component: Rear axle horizontal mounting bolt fracture (driveshaft may disconnect / rollaway)
22V486.note: NHTSA 22V-486 / Ford 22S27; ~238k Explorers. Explorer-only — was misapplied to F-150 (removed wave5).

22V076.component: High-voltage battery pack fire risk (LG cell defect)

20V575.component: Rearview camera image may blank or distort (FMVSS 111, Ford 20C19); MY2019-2020 F-Series/Explorer/Ranger/Expedition/Escape/Edge/Mustang/Transit + Lincoln Corsair/Nautilus

22V875.component: Dash-side wiring harness connector corrosion, fire risk; 2017 Rogue (PC934), 125,215 units

verified.23V093: Nissan 23V-093 (R22C5) — 2014-2020 Rogue + 2017-2022 Rogue Sport jackknife ignition key may collapse, can shut off engine; per NHTSA campaign 23V093000 / Justia / CarComplaints. Correctly used on nissan-rogue-2017.

20V191.component: Rearview camera image remains on display (VP4 radio software, FMVSS 111)
20V191.note: Covers 2020 Gladiator; defect was mislabeled as throttle-position-sensor in checklist (corrected)

22V412.component: HV battery main contactors overheat — loss of drive power (Ford 22S41)
22V412.note: 2021-2022 Mustang Mach-E; replaced fabricated 21V-803 (Tiger truck-camper window recall)

18V568.component: Front seat-belt pretensioner can ignite B-pillar insulation/wiring — fire (Ford 18S27)
18V568.note: 2015-2018 F-150 Reg Cab/SuperCrew; replaced fabricated 16V-170 (no such F-150 IP-wiring fire recall)

19V434.component: Moisture/water ingress into HV battery — fire risk
19V434.note: 2019 e-tron; replaced fabricated 20V-092 (Bentley airbag inflator recall)

23V838.component: Autosteer controls insufficient to prevent misuse (Autopilot) — OTA, 2012-2023 S / 2016-2023 X / 2017-2023 Model 3 / 2020-2023 Model Y

24V376.component: Seat belt warning light/chime may not activate (FMVSS 208), SB-24-00-008 — 2012-2024 S / 2015-2024 X / 2017-2023 Model 3 / 2020-2023 Model Y

12V491.component: Driver power-window master switch (overheat/fire) — Safety Recall C0M
12V491.note: real number; removed misapplied out-of-scope uses on lexus-rx350-2011, toyota-tacoma-2012, toyota-4runner-2008, toyota-highlander-2010

21V247.component: Rear suspension module incorrect-component labeling error (Ford 21S47)
21V247.note: real number but covers MY2021 module-labeling, not a 2020-Aviator air-suspension-hose chafe; removed misapplied use on lincoln-aviator-2020

21V259.component: 2.0L Nu MPI piston oil-ring excessive hardness — oil consumption/engine (Kia SC209)
21V259.note: real KIA engine recall fabricated onto 4 GM checklists (Equinox/Enclave/Traverse/Acadia) as 'cross-traffic braking' — all removed

13V583.component: 1.6L EcoBoost localized cylinder-head overheating -> head cracking -> oil leak onto hot surfaces -> under-hood fire (Ford 13S12)
13V583.scope: MY2013 Escape with 1.6L (built 2011-10-05 thru 2013-06-02); ~139,917 US units; 13 fires reported
13V583.note: replaced fabricated 13V-261 (a 2006-2012 Ford E-series Ricon wheelchair-lift armored-cable recall) on ford-escape-2013; 13V-583/13S12 is the canonical 1.6L EcoBoost engine-fire campaign (carcomplaints 13v583000)

17V418.component: Battery sensor water intrusion (fire risk), 2013-2016 Accord; Honda KG0
17V418.source: NHTSA 17V-418 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2014 Accord complete set)

20V769.component: Drive shafts, 2013-2015 Accord 4-cyl CVT, 22 salt-belt states
20V769.source: NHTSA 20V-769 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2014 Accord complete set)

17V123.component: Driver frontal airbag may not fully inflate, 2016-2017 Edge/MKX + 2017 Continental; Ford 17C02
17V123.source: NHTSA 17V-123 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2017 Edge complete set)

17V205.component: Panoramic Vista Roof windshield header weld, FMVSS 214, 2017 Edge; Ford 17C05
17V205.source: NHTSA 17V-205 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2017 Edge complete set)

18V390.component: Torque converter weld studs, 2017-2018 Edge / 2017 MKZ 2.0L; Ford 17S16(S2), expansion of 17V-427
18V390.source: NHTSA 18V-390 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2017 Edge complete set)

20V469.component: Front brake hoses may rupture, 2015-2018 Edge / 2016-2018 MKX; Ford 20S42
20V469.source: NHTSA 20V-469 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2017 Edge complete set)

22V413.component: Shift cable bushing degradation (roll-away), 2015-2018 Edge + Escape/C-Max/Fusion/Transit Connect; Ford 22S43
22V413.source: NHTSA 22V-413 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2017 Edge complete set)

25V544.component: Rear brake jounce hose rupture, 2015-2018 Edge / 2016-2018 MKX; Ford 25S87
25V544.source: NHTSA 25V-544 (cars.com/NHTSA recall feed, 2017 Edge complete set)
